 In Oh! My Guard , a woman wakes from an accident convinced she’s living inside her favourite K-drama (Korean drama), and that premise is the hook of Viu ‘s November 2026 line-up. If you’re in Singapore and your watchlist runs on idols, this guide lists every new title, with Red Velvet’s Joy and CNBLUE’s Jung Yong-hwa leading the charge.
 Title Genre Who to look for On Viu 
 Oh! My Guard Korean drama Jung Yong-hwa (CNBLUE), Hong Seung-hee Now streaming 
 One-of-a-Kind Romance Korean drama Joy (Red Velvet), Kim Hyun-jin From 9 Nov 
 Good Partner 2 Korean drama Jang Na-ra, Kim Hye-yoon From 20 Nov 
 IDOL’S TABLE Korean variety Jaemin and Chenle (NCT Dream), Bambam (GOT7) Now streaming 
 My Sibling’s Romance Season 2 Korean variety Miyeon ((G)I-DLE), Code Kunst TBC 
 Mission: Mompossible Korean drama Jung Min-ah, Dong Ha Now streaming 
 Small Town Remedy Chinese drama Xiao Zhan, Jiang Yan Now streaming 
 The Lament of Autumn Chinese drama Cheng Lei, Xu Ruo Han Now streaming 
 Quite the Girl Chinese drama Xu Meng Jie, Ren Shi Hao Now streaming 
 We Go Fast On Trust Chinese drama Alice Ko, Zhai Zi Lu TBC 
 Incomplete Summer Chinese variety Wang Rui Jian, Ma Wei Xian, Zhou Guo Rui Now streaming 
 Incomplete Summer: Side Stories Chinese variety Wang Rui Jian, Ma Wei Xian, Zhou Guo Rui Now streaming 
 Rising Romance Chinese short Kai Mu, Xu Zhen Zhen Now streaming 
 Burn For You Chinese short He Jian Qi, Zhong Li Li Now streaming 
 Fated to Love You Chinese short Hei Ze, Yue Yu Ting Now streaming 
 From Ruin to Ring English short Viu Shorts title Now streaming 
 The Curse of the Midas Touch Short Viu Shorts title Now streaming 
 Wake Up Inside a K-Drama
 In Oh! My Guard , Oh Hae-ra comes round after an accident sure she has been dropped into her favourite drama. She decides her job is to protect its male lead, Um Tae-bong. He’s played by Jung Yong-hwa of CNBLUE, so a member of a band you might have on a playlist spends the series as the fictional hero someone has sworn to guard. Hong Seung-hee shares top billing.
 Oh! My Guard’s key art puts its heroine on a stack of retro TVs, with the drama’s male lead looking out from every screen Every K-drama viewer has entertained this fantasy at 2am, three episodes past bedtime, and the premise sells the show without any help. It’s already live on Viu, so you have time to binge the opening episodes before the month’s bigger arrivals land!
 📺 Now streaming on Viu · 🎬 Korean drama · ⭐ Jung Yong-hwa, Hong Seung-hee 
 Joy Steps Into Another World
 Joy from Red Velvet heads the K-pop crossover list in One-of-a-Kind Romance . The show follows a chance connection that pulls two people from vastly different worlds into each other’s lives. Viu lists it from Monday, 9 November , with Kim Hyun-jin , Kang Na-eon and Shin Hyun-soo completing the cast.
 Viu has kept the plot details close to its chest. Joy is the reason to tune in, and Red Velvet fans finally have a firm date to circle, which is good news for anyone who has been waiting to see her lead a romance!
 📅 From Mon 9 Nov · 🎬 Korean drama · ⭐ Joy (Red Velvet), Kim Hyun-jin, Kang Na-eon, Shin Hyun-soo 
 Good Partner Opens Its Own Firm
 Good Partner 2 brings back veteran divorce lawyer Cha Eun Kyung, played by Jang Na-ra . This time she runs her own law firm. A new rookie lawyer joins her team, and the season follows the relationships and challenges that come up as they handle work, life and everything in between.
 Good Partner 2 pulls up a chair, and its Friday start suits a weekend in Kim Hye-yoon, Park Hae-jin and Pyo Ji-hoon, who goes by P.O., round out the cast. Viu has it streaming from Friday, 20 November , so it’s the latest-dated K-drama on the month’s list. That Friday start makes it a natural pick for a weekend in.
 📅 From Fri 20 Nov · 🎬 Korean drama · ⭐ Jang Na-ra, Kim Hye-yoon, Park Hae-jin, Pyo Ji-hoon (P.O.) 
 Idols Pull Up a Chair
 If you’d rather see idols as themselves, IDOL’S TABLE is the Korean variety show to queue up. The line-up includes NCT Dream’s Jaemin and Chenle , GOT7’s Bambam , Hearts2Hearts’ Carmen and Billie Tsuki. They’re joined by Kim Poong and Lee Eun-ji, the pair known from the Earth Arcade series.
 Idols in red and checkered outfits gather around the table with a host in plaid on the IDOL’S TABLE key art Two NCT Dream members at one table will be the headline for plenty of fans. Because the show is already up, it’s the quickest idol fix on this list. Miyeon of (G)I-DLE turns up later in My Sibling’s Romance Season 2 , a Korean variety series that also features Han Hye-jin, Code Kunst, Jonathan Yiombi and Patricia Yiombi, and Viu has not yet confirmed the date (listed as TBC).
 📺 Now streaming on Viu · 🎬 Korean variety · ⭐ Jaemin, Chenle, Bambam, Carmen, Billie Tsuki, Kim Poong, Lee Eun-ji 
 Pull up a seat at Idol’s Table Beyond the Idol Picks
 Mission: Mompossible is the Korean drama for viewers who want a break from the idol crossovers. Its cast includes Jung Min-ah, Dong Ha, Kim Hee-jung and Kang Kyung-hun. On the Chinese side, Small Town Remedy pairs Xiao Zhan, of Legend of Zang Hai , with Jiang Yan, and his fans should start with this one from the group.
 The Mission: Mompossible cast laughs together against a bright yellow backdrop in the show’s key art The Lament of Autumn , starring Cheng Lei and Xu Ruo Han, is set in another era. It explores how an unexpected encounter and circumstances beyond anyone’s control can change the course of love. Quite the Girl , with Xu Meng Jie and Ren Shi Hao, is available now as well. The streaming date for Alice Ko and Zhai Zi Lu’s We Go Fast On Trust is still to be confirmed.
 Chinese variety fans get Incomplete Summer and its companion series Incomplete Summer: Side Stories . Both feature Wang Rui Jian, Ma Wei Xian and Zhou Guo Rui.
 📺 Now streaming on Viu · 🎬 Korean drama, Chinese drama and Chinese variety 
 Shorts for the MRT Ride
 Viu Shorts carries five short-form titles, which fit neatly into a ride on the MRT (Singapore’s Mass Rapid Transit). Rising Romance , with Kai Mu and Xu Zhen Zhen, arrived on Sunday, 1 November . Burn For You , Fated to Love You , the English-language From Ruin to Ring and The Curse of the Midas Touch are already available.
 To find them, download or update the Viu mobile app to the latest version. Then tap “Shorts” in the navigation bar at the bottom of the home screen.
 📅 Rising Romance since Sun 1 Nov · 📱 Viu mobile app, “Shorts” tab 
 Where to Start This November
 Start with Oh! My Guard . You can watch it now, and no other show on the slate has a premise this much fun. Keep One-of-a-Kind Romance for when you want Joy on screen.
 You can watch Viu for free or subscribe to Viu Premium for exclusive content and extra perks. Open Viu’s Singapore site or app and add these to your list before November’s weekends fill up, because Oh Hae-ra won’t be the only one who never wants to leave her favourite drama!
 Photos and Visuals courtesy of Viu.
